purpose: Forward model: predict the canonical-mask l=1 chirality residual AMPLITUDE from the depth/morphology imaging systematic, to test whether the paper's attribution of the +3.64 sigma residual is quantitatively demonstrated (Grok external-review flag: attribution without a forward model).

config.fit: weighted_least_squares (galaxy-count weights); SYSTEMATIC-ONLY basis (no dipole vectors)

verdict_text: The systematic forward model predicts an l=1 amplitude 3.785e-03 = 52% of the observed 7.229e-03 (predicted equivalent significance +0.73 sigma vs observed +3.64). The depth/PSF/EBV/leg/density systematic accounts for a SUBSTANTIAL but INCOMPLETE fraction of the residual. Attribution is supported in sign and partially in amplitude; the un-modelled remainder (per-galaxy morphology b/a, fracdev, shape_r; classifier depth-response) is the honest open gap.
honesty_note: Systematic templates available locally: brick-level depth (psfdepth grz), PSF FWHM (psfsize grz), EBV, imaging-leg fractions, source density + density^2. NOT available locally and therefore NOT in this forward model: per-galaxy morphology (b/a, fracdev, shape_r_eff, shapedev_e1/e2; DR8-sweep/pod-bound) and the classifier confidence-vs-depth response as a per-pixel template. This model is therefore a LOWER BOUND on the systematic-predicted l=1 amplitude.
